brief: The canvas depicts a deeply textured, arid savanna bathed in rich terracotta earth tones beneath a contrasting beige sky. The scene is structured by the jagged silhouette of distant rock formations breaking the horizon line. Sunlight is rendered at a low, dramatic angle, which intensifies the shadows trapped within the ground’s intricate network of cracks and fissures. The ground itself is highly detailed, showing visible cracks and textures, and the composition is crossed by faint, organized dust devils that drift gently across the expanse. The environment appears self-contained, focusing solely on this richly detailed natural moment.

statement: This sketch renders a serene yet dramatic savanna landscape using p5.js. The composition is structured around a rich palette of terracotta earth tones against a soft beige sky, capturing the essence of an arid environment. Distant jagged rock formations break the horizon, while intricate ground textures reveal detailed cracks and fissures that emphasize the harshness of the terrain. Gentle dust devils drift across the expanse, adding subtle motion to the otherwise static scene. The piece emphasizes texture and light through careful layering and color transitions, creating a moment frozen in time that evokes the stillness and beauty of a remote landscape.
